open_questions: Is ADIM-6 (E-FULL measured return_bw + full adaptive ACK decimation) inside v1 scope? Spec §12 is normative ('cold-start + genel') but §3.3-E defers the FULL body to ADIM-6 and docs/reports/TRANSPORT-OLGUNLUK-RAPORU-2026-09-02.md:76,109 record it as an open debt gated on M4/M5 sensing. Classification of the two WIRE records (E-FULL, ACK decimation) flips to KEEP-EXPERIMENTAL if the owner declares them post-v1.

Is the ACK_FRAME_V2 seen_count consumer ('K3 tüketicisi', spec §2.2:187 + TV D3 line 963) v1 scope? Without it the product has no forward-vs-return loss discrimination and TDD §9 REVERSE_PATH diagnosis cannot be built.
